description: Make an image, a clip, a voice line or music in the Studio (spends credits; you confirm the cost in a dialog): `kind`, a `prompt`, optionally a `model` (studio_overview), `aspect_ratio`, `duration` (seconds, clips), `count` (images), `voice` (a voice key, for kind audio with purpose voice), `purpose` (voice|music for audio), `references` (media ids). Returns the media ids (status queued): read them later with get_media.

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

name: generate_media
title: Generate media
